description: c3849 Wave 7 runtime smoke: pack the Needler typed .pdweapon mod as a real .pdmod, enable it, force its custom catalog weapon into a first-person Combat Simulator match, and prove the default-on weapon graph runtime ingests held, projectile, mesh, and effect source without falling back.

input_sequence.comment: boot, pack and enable Needler .pdmod, ingest embedded typed dependencies, seed Combat Simulator, and force the custom weapon into first-person.

input_sequence.name: ACTION_AIM_DOWN
input_sequence.comment: aim the real player/gun trajectory down toward ordinary nearby world collision.

input_sequence.name: ACTION_FIRE_PRIMARY
input_sequence.comment: exercise default-on primary graph projectile path after cold archive loading settles.

input_sequence.name: ACTION_FIRE_MODE
input_sequence.comment: select the authored secondary function through the normal fire-mode control.

input_sequence.name: ACTION_FIRE_PRIMARY
input_sequence.comment: fire the selected public burst projectile steeply into world collision; captures bracket the measured impact and authored 1.5-second fade.

input_sequence.name: ACTION_AIM_DOWN
input_sequence.comment: release normal aim input after the complete impact window.
leave time for cold archive loading, held model render, screenshot capture, projectile graph lookups, and effect dependency ingestion.

required_lines: modmgr: discovered mod \[\d+\] 'needler'.*\[\.pdmod\] from 'installed' file=.*installed.*needler\.pdmod sha256=[0-9a-f]+\.\.
assetcatalog_scanner: archive needler: \d+ component descriptors registered
SETUP: user-picked spawn weapon 'mod_needler:needler' num=\d+ preserved
EFFECT\.GAMEPLAY\.AUDIT: committed asset=mod_needler:pink_burst_effect instance=\d+ explosion=1 spark=1 smoke=0 particle=0 audio=1 audio_id=mod_needler:pink_burst_sfx soundnum=\d+ channel=\d+
EFFECT\.INSTANCE\.AUDIT: committed asset=mod_needler:pink_burst_effect instance=\d+ consumers=2 lifetime=1\.500
EFFECT\.PRESENTATION\.RENDER\.AUDIT: instance=\d+ snapshots=[1-9]\d* channel=2 shader=needler_pink_burst intensity=
BONDGUN\.SOURCE: loaded catalog model source filenum=\d+ id=mod_needler:needler_model path=.*needler\.pdweapon::dependencies/assets/models/weapon\.pdmesh::model\.gltf
MODASSET\.RENDER: generated source modeldef rendered id=mod_needler:needler_model source=.*dependencies/assets/models/weapon\.pdmesh::model\.gltf
SPAWN: player 0 spawned with weapon \d+ \([^)]*\) -- auto-equipped to right hand
BOOT: --debug-force-first-person active: stagenum=0x43 frame=\d+ before=\d+ after=0 frames=900
forbidden_patterns: weapon_graph_runtime: held IR unavailable for mod_needler:needler

required_counts.pattern: BONDGUN\.SOURCE: loaded catalog model source filenum=\d+ id=mod_needler:needler_model
MODASSET\.RENDER: generated source modeldef rendered id=mod_needler:needler_model
